_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

court_type.label: Court Type
court_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

county_probate.label: County Probate
county_probate.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

district_court_location.label: District Court Location
district_court_location.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

docket_no_probate.label: Docket No Probate
docket_no_probate.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

docket_no_district.label: Docket No District
docket_no_district.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

minor_name.label: Minor Name
minor_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

guardian_name.label: Guardian Name
guardian_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

appointment_type.label: Appointment Type
appointment_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

duration_type.label: Duration Type
duration_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

guardian_full_name.label: Guardian Full Name
guardian_full_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

guardian_address.label: Guardian Address
guardian_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

notary_county.label: Notary County
notary_county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

notary_appearer_name.label: Notary Appearer Name
notary_appearer_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
